integrity: Complete reproducible deterministic finite matching and exact signed Morse differential included. No claim of independent review.
scientific_limitations: The calculation is for one 25-vertex periodic graph; it proves ordinary integral homotopy but no general grid theorem or equivariant decomposition. Rational Betti multiplicities 51 and 15 are already tabulated by Huijse et al. 2011. Publication priority and independent mathematical validation remain open.
title: Integral homotopy of the five-by-five periodic triangular hard-hexagon complex
